note: Town list of this section for the town pages /xk/qytetet/ (scripts/loc_towns.py, K5 09.11.2026). A station belongs to the nearest town of this list within 25 km; a town has a page with at least 3 public stations or when `page` is true (pinned: a town that has a page keeps it — unpin only with a redirect). Reference: GeoNames towns from 5,000 inhabitants plus resorts and transit towns from 1,000 (CC BY 4.0, attribution on the pages), only towns that had a station on 26.10.2026; every row checked by hand. Fields: name (local official), slug, gid (GeoNames id), lat/lon (GeoNames), pop, loc (locative with preposition), region, aliases, page, note.

towns.name: Prishtinë
towns.note: GeoNames pop 550000 is a metro estimate, not a census figure. One station is in Graçanicë and one in Çagllavicë (assigned here as nearest town).

towns.name: Fushë Kosovë
towns.note: Separate municipality adjacent to Prishtinë (~6 km). Of its 3 stations one is addressed 'Prishtinë' and one 'Lipjan' (Lipjan is not in the list) — check before publishing as its own page.

towns.name: Suharekë
towns.note: GeoNames name is the Serbian form; Albanian official form Suharekë.
